purpose: Reassess current Sandero Stepway configurator evidence against the already assimilated dated documentary boundary.

historical_boundary.scope: Sandero and Sandero Stepway price matrix dated 2026-08-11

documentary_coverage.remaining_documentary_gap: No repository evidence currently justifies re-importing the same historical Sandero Stepway commercial/equipment data.

current_web_reassessment.source: official Dacia Stepway configurator and version pages

reconciliation_findings.finding: Current Stepway configurator is not a historical 2026-08-11 price source.
reconciliation_findings.action: Do not overwrite or backfill the 2026-08-11 master values from current web values.

reconciliation_findings.finding: Current web availability differs by grade; Essential currently exposes fewer powertrains than Expression/Extreme.
reconciliation_findings.action: Record only as current-web dependency evidence if a dedicated current-state dataset is required; do not infer historical unavailability.

reconciliation_findings.finding: Current configurator exposes option-state information not needed to reconstruct the already assimilated 2026-08-11 historical matrix.
reconciliation_findings.action: No master import in this package.

residual_gap.required_scope: Only option/engine/color/wheel/trim dependency states that are not already represented by dated documentary evidence.
residual_gap.next_action: Use connected configurator session to enumerate residual current-state dependencies, beginning with Stepway Expression and Extreme.

negative_evidence_rule: A current configurator omission is not evidence that an option or powertrain was historically unavailable.
